title: Memorial evening for the Łuków ghetto martyrs
summary: A Yizkor memorial evening for the martyrs of the Łuków ghetto was organized by the committee of Łuków Jews in Bad Reichenhall on 17 June 1947.
uncertaintyNote: The event is a memorial evening; ORGANIZATION_FOUNDING is not an exact fit, so this candidate is low confidence.
